d:
Five rivers, one soul: Punjab Watch Panj Dariya, written, composed and sung by Satinder Sartaaj, with music by Jatinder Shah, now brought to life in a stunning new visual.
Sartaaj's poetry and soulful voice pay tribute to the land of the five rivers, its people, its spirit and everything that makes Punjab home. A song to make every Punjabi, near or far, feel proud
Song Credits
Song: Panj Dariya
Singer, Lyrics & Composer: Satinder Sartaaj
Music Director: Jatinder Shah
Label: Speed Records
